## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Cyclicals/Financials leading (JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +9.98%), CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +14.61%)) and Growth + Value both showing participation (INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +51.85%)); Leadership concentrated (3/5 Technology).

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Utilities strength: VST ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.87% | 1M: +21.56%), CEG ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.09% | 1M: +5.14%) — Utilities: 8/10 positive (Sector Strength). Financials strong: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +9.98%), COF ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.71% | 1M: +10.71%) — Financials: 14/20 positive (Sector Strength). Industrials solid: CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +14.61%), BA ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.49% | 1M: +3.59%) — Industrials: 10/15 positive (Internal Rotation).

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Energy weak: XOM BELOW TREND (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -15.22%), CVX BELOW TREND (1W: -6.56% | 1M: -11.97%) — Energy: 2/10 positive (Sector Weakness). Healthcare lagging: JNJ BELOW TREND (1W: -4.17% | 1M: -0.13%), LLY CORRECTION (1W: -5.37% | 1M: +7.55%) — Healthcare: 5/17 positive (Sector Weakness). Communication under pressure: CHTR BELOW TREND (1W: -9.28% | 1M: -11.42%), TTWO ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.83% | 1M: +0.48%) — Communication: 4/10 positive (Internal Rotation).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%), TTWO ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.83% | 1M: +0.48%), VST ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.87% | 1M: +21.56%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +51.85%), QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.41% | 1M: +16.02%); Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: ACN BELOW TREND (1W: -23.60% | 1M: -27.61%), ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -10.80% | 1M: -23.46%), SLB BELOW TREND (1W: -14.12% | 1M: -14.85%), CRM BELOW TREND (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -15.19%), CCI BELOW TREND (1W: -9.81% | 1M: -10.11%); Weakness concentrated in large-cap Technology and Energy names.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Biggest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +14.56%), TTWO (1W: +12.83%), VST (1W: +11.87%), AMAT (1W: +11.67%), QCOM (1W: +11.41%) — strong short-term rotation into tech equipment, semis, utilities and select financials. Major divergence: several mega-caps (MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -2.80% | 1M: -8.91%), AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +0.81% | 1M: -0.32%), NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +2.84% | 1M: -4.39%), GOOGL RECOVERY (1W: +2.87% | 1M: -5.01%), META RECOVERY (1W: +1.64% | 1M: -4.12%)) show 1W/1M mismatches — watch for trend breaks and tactical, not core, re-allocations.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed but constructive with rotation into chip names: AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +51.85%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.02% | 1M: +29.78%), while MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -2.80% | 1M: -8.91%) and ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -10.80% | 1M: -23.46%); Technology: 12/24 positive (Internal Rotation).

8. Financials Outlook?  
Broad strength in banks and card networks: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +9.98%), COF ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.71% | 1M: +10.71%), GS showing positive news flow — Financials: 14/20 positive (Sector Strength).

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Patchy and under pressure overall: UNH CORRECTION (1W: -0.57% | 1M: +3.60%), JNJ BELOW TREND (1W: -4.17% | 1M: -0.13%), LLY CORRECTION (1W: -5.37% | 1M: +7.55%) — Healthcare: 5/17 positive (Sector Weakness); defensive names not broadly leading.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor cyclicals/value exposure: Financials (JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +9.98%)), Industrials (CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +14.61%)) and selective semis (AMAT, INTC) given the current rotation; reduce exposure to lagging large-cap software names showing persistent downside (ACN BELOW TREND (1W: -23.60% | 1M: -27.61%), ADBE BELOW TREND). Style: Value/Cyclical favored, monitor mega-cap divergence before increasing core Growth exposure.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%) — positive sentiment and strong 1W; AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +51.85%) — follow-through on equipment demand; QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.41% | 1M: +16.02%) — watch earnings/revisions.  
BEARISH: ACN BELOW TREND (1W: -23.60% | 1M: -27.61%) — negative reaction to outlook; SLB BELOW TREND (1W: -14.12% | 1M: -14.85%) and XOM BELOW TREND (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -15.22%) — energy weakness to monitor.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Financials (14/20 positive) and Utilities (8/10 positive) for continued risk-on rotation into cyclicals and yield-sensitive names.  
BEARISH: Energy (2/10 positive) and Healthcare (5/17 positive) for continued underperformance and headline sensitivity.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +2.84% | 1M: -4.39%) — watch for break above prior 1M highs as confirmation of regained leadership.  
JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +9.98%) — sustained move above recent swing highs would confirm bank-led cyclical trend.  
AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +0.81% | 1M: -0.32%) — watch short-term support near recent pullback lows for possible base forming.  
ACN BELOW TREND (1W: -23.60% | 1M: -27.61%) — failure to reclaim weekly resistance would extend downside risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
INTC (+60): Trump comment on U.S. chip production; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%) — sentiment confirmed by sharp buying.  
TTWO (+55): GTA VI preorder date; TTWO ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.83% | 1M: +0.48%) — news-driven accumulation.  
EA (+85): Saudi bid headline; EA not in detailed table but large bullish catalyst — monitor price action for confirmation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
ACN (-50): Cautious outlook headlines; ACN BELOW TREND (1W: -23.60% | 1M: -27.61%) — sentiment confirmed by heavy selling.  
ORCL (-50): Capital raise/headline; ORCL not in detailed list here but watch for distribution if price follows.  
KO (-60): Tax/legal headline; KO not in detailed table — monitor for divergence if price remains stable despite negative headlines.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with a Value/Cyclical tilt given Financials and Industrials strength. INTC ABOVE TREND, AMAT ABOVE TREND and JPM ABOVE TREND are showing leadership. Key risk is major-cap divergence (MSFT, AAPL, NVDA, GOOGL, META mismatched 1W vs 1M) and negative sentiment around select large tech/software names (ACN/ADBE) that could blunt upside.
